pages.title: Alchemy Table
pages.text: A workbench for the most basic alchemy operations. $(br)When materials are laid out, it takes one second to create an item.

pages.title: Hermes's Workbench
pages.text: Developmental workbench for 5x5 work. $(br)When the materials are ready, it takes 2 seconds to create an item.

pages.title: Transcendental Table
pages.text: A workbench that allows crafts of a huge size, 13 x 13. $(br)When the materials are ready, the item is created over a period of 3 seconds.
